units: metres, seconds, health points; damage/healing are unscaled baseline inputs, not final shop-scaled results
integration: HeroRuntime emits onEffect({kind, source, target, ability, baseDamage, baseHeal, damageType, spiritScale, headshot, slow, duration}). Systems owns damage, item scaling, team filtering, armor and health. Effects never mutate system health. Pass already-scaled cooldowns or stats via runtime options if required.

heroes.name: Stampead
heroes.lore: The postroom's stamp inspector. Every dispute receives a heavy receipt.

abilities.name: Staple Line
abilities.description: Latch onto the first enemy or solid wall and pull yourself to it.

abilities.name: Stamp Volley
abilities.description: Fan five stamp blocks across a short cone. Each enemy receives one hit.

abilities.name: Desk Slam
abilities.description: Stamp the floor and slow nearby enemies, blocked by solid cover.

abilities.name: Overtime
abilities.description: Become invulnerable and run faster for three seconds.

heroes.name: Turretina
heroes.lore: A filing-room mechanic who insists the stapler should do the overtime.

abilities.name: Desk Deputy
abilities.description: Place a mini stapler turret. It tracks one visible enemy within range.

abilities.name: Filing Wall
abilities.description: Deploy a solid accordion-file barricade ahead for six seconds.

abilities.name: Bounce Notice
abilities.description: Throw a bouncing paperweight that bursts after its fuse.

abilities.name: Chain Clerk
abilities.description: Spin a six-barrel stapler for four seconds, firing while aimed.

heroes.name: Snipeoff
heroes.lore: A pencil-thin audit clerk who spots a missing decimal across the street.

abilities.name: Redline
abilities.description: Fire one long-range precision shot. Head hits use the weapon headshot multiplier.

abilities.name: Audit String
abilities.description: Tether the first visible enemy, slowing it until the tether breaks at cover or range.

abilities.name: Fine Print
abilities.description: For five seconds, precision headshots deal a larger bonus.

abilities.name: Open Ledger
abilities.description: Reveal enemy wire silhouettes through cover for six seconds. Shots still respect walls.

fx.shape: wireframe enemy cages and scope ring

heroes.name: Gooey Sticky
heroes.lore: An escaped glue-pot who keeps the postroom together, sometimes literally.

abilities.name: Paste Patch
abilities.description: Place a shallow glue pool ahead. It slows enemies and heals allies once per second.

abilities.name: Glue Burst
abilities.description: Burst glue in a short cone, heavily slowing enemies.

abilities.name: Missionbomb
abilities.description: Lob a sticky memo bomb that splats after a short fuse.

fx.shape: paper cube splatting into radial wedges

abilities.name: Group Adhesion
abilities.description: A giant puddle follows you, healing nearby allies once per second for six seconds.

fx.shape: wide solid pool with rising plus prisms
